input_decode: Original m4a -> ffmpeg PCM signed 16-bit mono 16 kHz WAV -> stdlib wave -> float32 samples /32768 -> faster-whisper
initial_runtime_issue: PyAV 19.0.1 open() rejected metadata_errors used by faster-whisper 1.2.1. No ASR output was produced by those initial attempts. Successful runs use PCM array input and bypass only that incompatible decoder API.
prompt_policy: Main base.en, small.en, medium.en runs have language en only and initial_prompt null. One separately named small.en-termlist run uses only a documented short glossary. The existing manuscript was never used as a model prompt.
